envelope.description: Extension wiring: scratch store construction + all host message handlers

body.title: Extension wiring: scratch store construction + all host message handlers
body.summary: Wire the feature in vscode-plugin/src/extension.ts: construct the scratch store with root join(PATHS.insrc, 'scratches') next to the attachment store (~:635), instantiate the scratch-panels controller with the factory (:447), and register all host message handlers (menu/new/open/delete/browse/send-to-chat incl. reveal+ready-handshake before insert-into-input, typed error replies, input validation). Plus extension-chat-wiring.test.ts. No daemon IPC.
acceptanceChecks: extension.ts constructs createScratchStore({ root: join(PATHS.insrc, 'scratches'), logger: panelLog }) next to the createAttachmentStore call (~:635) — fs omitted so the node default applies; root derives from PATHS.insrc (src/shared/paths.ts:4), never hard-coded

registers the six new webview->host handlers (scratch-open-menu -> scratch-list top 5; titleless scratch-new -> injected showInputBox boundary (extension.ts:606) then createScratch, cancel/empty-after-trim = no-op with unchanged list; scratch-open -> readScratch + document panel via the controller; scratch-delete -> delete then refresh open browse table and close document panel if it displays the id; scratch-browse -> unbounded listScratches + table panel; send-to-chat -> reveal chat panel, await its ready handshake, then push insert-into-input {text} capped at 65,536 UTF-8 bytes incl. ellipsis; disposed chat drops silently per :465-468 swallow pattern)
store failure replies 'scratch-list' { entries: [], error: 'scratchpads unavailable: <reason>' } (typed optional error field, attachments-pending pattern), distinct from a successful empty list
instantiates the scratch-panels controller with the panels factory (:447) and store and routes both panel message flows (browse rows, document send-to-chat)
non-string ids/texts/titles rejected by the host switch; unknown payload.type ignored without throwing

extension-chat-wiring.test.ts asserts the createScratchStore root wiring next to extension.ts:635; handler behaviors covered per acceptanceMapping (scratch-new cancel/answer end-to-end, scratch-list error row + later recovery, panel-factory failure -> undefined + logged + retry)
no daemon IPC anywhere: no LMDB/Lance/socket usage introduced (grep-verifiable)

tests.name: extension-chat-wiring.test.ts: extension.ts constructs createScratchStore with root join(PATHS.insrc, 'scratches') (ac1)
extension-chat-wiring.test.ts: scratch-new title acquisition end-to-end — prompt cancelled -> no create + unchanged list; prompt answered -> create + list refresh + document open
extension-chat-wiring.test.ts: scratch-list error field renders the unavailable row and a later success recovers; host switch cases for all six webview->host messages and both host->webview pushes
extension-chat-wiring.test.ts: send-to-chat reveals the chat panel, awaits the ready handshake, then pushes insert-into-input capped at 65,536 UTF-8 bytes; disposed chat drops silently

manual/optional smoke: click scratchpad button in the chat status bar, create a scratchpad, browse all, select text, Send to chat (only if a display/VS Code harness is available; otherwise covered by the integration fake-dom suite — no live LLM or daemon calls)
